name: clm
description: CLM in Claude Code: cheaper subagent models when CLM is confident, behavior checks when a turn ends, and a shadow classifier for tool calls.

api_key.title: CLM agent key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty and run /clm:login to get a personal key with your Metatheory Google account. Only for a key you were given by hand; stored in your keychain.

subagent_downgrades.title: Cheaper subagent models
subagent_downgrades.description: On: when CLM is confident a subagent task does not need the model it would run on, it runs on a cheaper one (downgrade only). Off: log only.

behavior_checks.title: Behavior checks
behavior_checks.description: On: when a turn ends CLM checks it (claimed success without checking, stale task, ...) and may ask Claude to fix it. Off: log only.

tool_gate.title: Tool-call gate
tool_gate.description: On: a confident review/block pick forces the permission prompt or denies the call. Off: log only.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key (optional)
jev_api_key.description: A TypeSafe key. With one, behavior checks act on the average of CLM and Jev, and unsure tool calls go to Jev. Stored in your keychain.
